content.short: KTON is a liquid staking protocol and Jetton that enables network validation participation with full asset liquidity.
content.description: KTON is a specialized liquid staking protocol and its associated Jetton on the TON blockchain. It is designed to facilitate participation in the network's validation process, allowing users to earn rewards while keeping their assets liquid. By utilizing KTON, stakers can maintain their position in the network and contribute to its security without locking up their funds for extended periods. This protocol enhances the overall robustness and accessibility of the TON validation ecosystem for a wider range of participants.
content.meta: Stake TON and maintain liquidity with KTON. Learn more about liquid staking on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
